title: Stack
learn: LIFO, list as stack, matching brackets, undo-style problems, expression evaluation
hook: Valid Parentheses is one of the most asked interview questions of all, and Min Stack and Evaluate RPN follow close behind. They all hinge on one question: do I need the most recent unfinished thing?

explain.prompt: Explain how you'd check that a string of brackets is valid, and why a stack is the right structure.
keyPoints: each closing bracket must match the most recent unmatched opening bracket: LIFO
push openers; on a closer, the stack must be non-empty and its top must be the matching opener, then pop
at the end the stack must be empty
